chunks: It was found inscribed on another stone: 'This is the Sacred House of Allah in Makkah. Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, has guaranteed the sustenance of its people through three blessed means. It is blessed for its people in meat and water.'

key_terms.اللَّحْمِ وَ الْمَاءِ: meat and water as mentioned forms of blessed provision
key_terms.بَيْتُ اللَّهِ الْحَرَامُ: the Sacred House of Allah, the Ka'bah in Makkah
key_terms.حَجَرٍ: a stone on which the inscription was found
key_terms.سُبُلٍ: means or channels through which provision comes

ai.seo_question: What does this narration say about the blessing and sustenance of the people of the Sacred House in Makkah?
ai.summary: This report relates an inscription found on a stone concerning Bayt Allah al-Haram in Makkah. It describes Allah's guaranteed provision and blessing for its people, highlighting the sanctity of the Sacred House and the blessed sustenance associated with it.
